2116943460565766477.en_summary: Incentives drive outcomes, only one way out: print money, state run capitalism imminent. Quoting Chamath concern on AI boom: largest AI companies $340-400B debt, needing more financing for data centers GPUs power, operating cash flow insufficient. Additional financing through end 2027 could equal ~30% of US Treasury issuance, competing for capital from same investors, potential higher yields pressuring valuations.
2116943460565766477.zh_summary: 激勵驅動結果，唯一出路：印鈔，國家資本主義迫在眉睫。引用Chamath對AI熱潮的擔憂：最大AI公司累積3400-4000億美元債務，需更多融資建數據中心GPU電力，營運現金流不足。至2027年底額外融資可能相當於美國財政部發行的約30%，與政府競爭相同投資者資本，可能推高收益率壓估值。
